style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=12;strokeColor=#AAB7B8;fillColor=#FFFFFF;rounded=0;" value="<b>Request flow</b><br><br><b>1</b>&nbsp; Users talk to an agent running on AgentCore Runtime.<br><br><b>2</b>&nbsp; The agent calls tools through AgentCore Gateway with a reason and precheck session metadata.<br><br><b>3</b>&nbsp; Gateway forwards MCP calls to the precheck proxy (MCP target, untested). Deterministic rules run in-process.<br><br><b>4</b>&nbsp; Rules that still need judgment send only their state_template fields to Jev through the NAT gateway.<br><br><b>5</b>&nbsp; Allowed calls reach your tools and results are checked on return. Denied calls get an error; escalated calls get an escalation ID.<br><br><b>6</b>&nbsp; The proxy pulls live policy (fails closed until first load) and reports decision events and escalations.<br><br><b>7</b>&nbsp; Reviewers reach the web UI over Client VPN to approve escalations and publish rules. No built-in auth in the MVP.<br><br><b>8</b>&nbsp; The translator calls the Anthropic API to draft rules from plain language." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="510" width="300" x="1530" y="430" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Request flow
1 Users talk to an agent running on AgentCore Runtime.
2 The agent calls tools through AgentCore Gateway with a reason and precheck session metadata.
3 Gateway forwards MCP calls to the precheck proxy (MCP target, untested). Deterministic rules run in-process.
4 Rules that still need judgment send only their state_template fields to Jev through the NAT gateway.
5 Allowed calls reach your tools and results are checked on return. Denied calls get an error; escalated calls get an escalation ID.
6 The proxy pulls live policy (fails closed until first load) and reports decision events and escalations.
7 Reviewers reach the web UI over Client VPN to approve escalations and publish rules. No built-in auth in the MVP.
8 The translator calls the Anthropic API to draft rules from plain language.
